nodes.name: power_3v3_mcu
nodes.description: XC6206 LDO (U1) steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3_MCU for the MCU domain. Provides a stable 3.3 V rail to downstream MCU and MCU‑side isolator. Bypass caps required at input and output. No connection to ISO_GND.
3.3V LDO for non-isolated side

nodes.name: power_3v3_iso
nodes.description: XC6206 LDO (U2) steps ISO_5V down to VCC_3V3_ISO for the isolated domain. Supplies the isolated‑side isolator and ADS1118. Bypass caps required. Rail is isolated from system ground.
3.3V LDO for isolated-side digital supply

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 (U3) runs from VCC_3V3_MCU, uses system GND. Generates SPI bus to the isolated side: SCLK, CS, DIN as outputs, DOUT as input. BOOT0 pulled low for Flash boot. NRST pulled up. All SPI pins are isolated via ISO7721 pair.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU
